column1: # This file defines the multi-step lost load costs.
# It is only read if 'lost_load_cost_mode' is set to 'multi_step_v1' in the settings.
# capacity_MWh: The amount of lost load available at this cost step.
# cost_EUR_per_MWh: The cost for each MWh of lost load in this step.
# The last step should have a very large capacity to represent an 'unlimited' amount.
